question: Approximately 85% of proximal humerus fractures are minimally displaced or undisplaced and are suitable for non-operative management.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is true. About 85% of proximal humerus fractures are 1- or 2-part injuries that do not require surgery. Only significantly displaced multi-part fractures — particularly 3-part and 4-part injuries in appropriate patients — warrant operative intervention.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The large majority (~85%) of proximal humerus fractures are 1-part or 2-part fractures that are minimally displaced; these are managed with a sling, early pendulum exercises, and physiotherapy.
